header.running_head: 3. Belief in the Events after Death...

blocks.tamil_translation: above questions, has answered correctly in this way) a caller will call from the heavens; an announcement is made in the heavens from Allah: “My servant has spoken the truth; spread for him the bedding of Jannah, clothe him in the garments of Jannah, open for him a door of Jannah,” Allah will say, and accordingly” that door is opened. From it the pleasant breeze and fragrances of Jannah keep coming, and the grave is widened for that man as far as the eye can see. (This was the Prophet ﷺ describing the events that happen to a believer.) After that the Prophet ﷺ spoke about the state of the kafir. “His soul will be brought back into his body; then two angels will come to him, make him sit up and ask him, “Who is your Lord?’ He will say, “Alas! Woe is me! I know nothing!’ Then those two angels will ask him, “What is your religion?’ He will say, “Alas! Woe is me, I know nothing”! Next, the two of them will ask him, “What do you think about this man who was sent to you (as a Prophet)?’ To that too he will answer, “Alas! Woe is me, I know nothing at all.” (After these questions and answers) a caller will announce from the heavens, “He is lying!” Then (from Allah) an announcer will announce, “Spread for him a bedding of fire, clothe him in a garment of fire, open for him a door of Jahannam”. (And accordingly” all of it will be done.) (From that door of Jahannam) the heat of Jahannam and its scorching, burning hot wind will keep coming to him.
